job_post_detail.title: Software Engineer - Data Development
job_post_detail.description:
1. Support the operation, maintenance, and development of the company’s overseas data warehouse (mobile device, IoT, and app data domains)
2. Develop and implement data processing techniques and analytics applications to transform raw data into meaningful insights
3. Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using data-oriented programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL) 
4. Apply basic data modeling and data mining techniques to process structured and semi-structured datasets
5. Assist in analyzing large datasets and generating insights to support overseas business operations
6. Create data visualizations and simple reports using BI or visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
7. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and support analytics use cases
8. Participate in testing, deployment, and monitoring of data workflows
job_post_detail.requirement:
1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
2. Familiarity with big data frameworks such as Hadoop, Spark, or Flink
3. Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python, Java, or Scala)
4. Basic understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts
5. Exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
6. Basic knowledge of data mining or machine learning concepts is a plus
7. Good communication and teamwork skills, Mandarin proficiency is a plus
